subject: MicroLedger — PO reissue, spend cap split, and line normalization
messages:
From: David Suarez <david.suarez@microledger.io>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ap@microledger.io
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Request for provisional PO and missing tax info

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. We're ready to move forward with onboarding and would like to get a provisional PO to start initial provisioning (usage is expected to begin in early December). I attached our completed onboarding form — small note, the tax ID field was left blank on the version we returned. I can send the official tax doc once I confirm the correct internal billing code.

Request: can Redwood issue a provisional PO for $48,000 with a 6-month spend cap, split across two line items (Platform usage / Professional services)? We're asking for two line items to match how we plan to expense internally.

Attached: MicroLedger_Onboarding_Form.pdf (filled), PO-7682_Draft.csv (vendor-proposed line split)

Please let me know if you need anything else to authorize the provisional PO.

Best,
David Suarez
Head of Partnerships
MicroLedger

Onboarding notes: MicroLedger is a mid-market fintech integrator, expects monthly spikes in token usage around product launches. Contact for billing: Finance AP <ap@microledger.io>.
From: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
To: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request for provisional PO and missing tax info

Kimberly / Monica — forwarding MicroLedger's request. Key asks: provisional PO for $48k, split into two line items (Platform / Services), and a 6-month spend cap. They haven't submitted tax ID in the form.

Two operational asks from our side:
- We should avoid creating a single PO that lumps both items under one spend cap bucket if they want separate cost centers. Please indicate whether we can support a single PO with two line items and a single consolidated spend cap, or if we need to issue two POs each tied to its own spend bucket.
- If we reissue a PO (they referenced PO-7682 draft), we should normalize line item descriptions to match our ledger taxonomy (product_codes: INF_GEN / SVC_IMPL).

Aditya — please advise on temporary provisional issuance process and whether we need proof of tax ID before we assign a provisional PO number. If vendor provides tax doc within 48 hours, can we annotate the PO as provisional then finalize?

I'll hold on sending MicroLedger our standard onboarding packet until Kimberly confirms the spend mapping.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Director, Commercial GTM
Redwood Inference
From: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request for provisional PO and missing tax info

Jonas — thanks. Quick notes from procurement:

1) We can issue a single PO number with multiple line items and attach a single cumulative spend cap. Our systems support per-line accounting tags, so expense owners can map lines to cost centers. That avoids creating two POs.

2) We'll normalize descriptions to our ledger taxonomy before creating the PO. Please confirm final descriptions below so we can avoid back-and-forth:
   - Line 1: INF_GEN — Platform (Consumption) — quantity: variable — spend cap allocation: $36,000
   - Line 2: SVC_IMPL — Professional Services (Onboarding & Integration) — fixed — spend cap allocation: $12,000

3) Proof of tax ID is not strictly required to issue a provisional PO but IS required before we promote to a committed PO and before payment runs. We can add a provisional flag to the PO metadata and a conditioned hold in the ledger if tax docs are outstanding.

4) Attach a provisional PO note template to the record and include a field the vendor can sign to acknowledge the spend cap and line allocations.

Action items:
- Monica: please create PO-7682 provisional in draft state, normalize descriptions per above, and set metadata flag "provisional_pending_tax". Add DocuSign link for vendor acknowledgement.
- Aditya: confirm whether temporary spend guard rules can auto-block spend if monthly run-rate exceeds 25% of remaining cap (we want a conservative early-warning).

I'll prepare the normalized line descriptions and return with the draft PO number.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
From: David Suarez <david.suarez@microledger.io>
To: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ap@microledger.io, lina.park@microledger.io
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 06:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MicroLedger — PO reissue, spend cap split, and line normalization

Kimberly / Jonas — thanks for the clear path. Attached is the vendor tax certificate you asked for (proof_of_tax_id.pdf). We accept the suggested line split and allocation; please proceed with the provisional PO in draft.

Two clarifying points:
- Can the provisional PO include a clause that allows MicroLedger to reallocate up to 10% of the total spend between the two lines without renegotiation? Occasionally our services ramp into platform usage during sprint periods.
- For DocuSign, please send the vendor acknowledgement to lina.park@microledger.io and cc Finance AP (ap@microledger.io).

Attached: proof_of_tax_id.pdf

Thanks,
David Suarez
Head of Partnerships, MicroLedger

Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Final: PO-7682 (provisional) issued and DocuSign sent

David / team — sending final confirmation. I created provisional PO-7682-PR (provisional) in the procurement system with the normalized lines and spend allocations you confirmed:

- PO-7682-PR (provisional) — total cap $48,000
  - Line 1 (INF_GEN): Platform (Consumption) — cap $36,000
  - Line 2 (SVC_IMPL): Professional Services — cap $12,000

Notes:
- The PO is flagged provisional_pending_tax in the ledger, but I attached the received tax certificate to the PO record and uploaded proof_of_tax_id.pdf. Once legal reviews the DocuSign acknowledgement and we verify the tax cert, we'll flip status to active and remove the provisional flag.
- DocuSign acknowledgement (vendor spend cap + line allocations) sent to Lina Park (lina.park@microledger.io) — HubSpot record updated: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/98765.
- Aditya, I set an early-warning spend guard to block further provisioning if the monthly burn exceeds 25% of the remaining cap; please advise if you want a stricter threshold.

Attachments on record: PO-7682_Draft.csv (archived), MicroLedger_Onboarding_Form.pdf, proof_of_tax_id.pdf

Next steps (for MicroLedger):
1) Sign DocuSign (acknowledgement of split & spend cap).
2) Reply to this thread once signed; procurement will promote PO status.

Thanks and welcome aboard,
Monica Patel
Procurement Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
